After announcing "The Dynasty: UConn Huskies" last May, Apple TV+ today released the first trailer for the documentary series, just weeks before its premiere next month. Watch the trailer below.

"What are you willing to build a dynasty?"

Last May, Apple TV+ announced the three-part documentary series "The Dynasty: UConn Huskies," telling the story of the University of Connecticut women's basketball team.

The platform today released the first trailer for the documentary, just weeks ahead of its August 21 premiere.

Here's how Apple TV+ describes "The Dynasty: UConn Huskies":

"The Dynasty: UConn Huskies" features interviews with "coaches, players, alumni, rivals, and reporters across eras of UConn basketball," and is directed by Matthew Hamachek ("Tiger") and Erica Sashin ("Wrong Man").

When "The Dynasty: UConn Huskies" premieres, it will join Apple TV+'s growing lineup of sports content, which includes "F1 The Movie," "Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series," "Onside: Major League Soccer," "Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend," and "Stephen Curry: Underrated," among others.

Watch the trailer for "The Dynasty: UConn Huskies" below:

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or it can be subscribed to as part of an Apple One bundle. The platform offers a number of hit shows and movies, including "Severance," "The Studio," "The Morning Show," "Shrinking," and "Silo," among others.
